entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi, yes, I... I need to return something. My VeloBand Pulse monitor.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your name and order number, please?
Sure, it's Alex Garcia. The order number is... um... VF789012.

Thank you, Alex. I have your account pulled up. I see the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor was delivered on December 15th. To get started, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, um, I guess it's a preference? It works fine, I think. I just... I sort of **changed my mind**. To be honest, it was a bit of an **impulse buy** and I just **don't use it** like I thought I would. The website was all a bit much and I'm just confused. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I understand completely. Let me just double-check our return policy against your delivery date. One moment, please.
Okay, Alex, I've got it here. I see the delivery was 29 days ago. According to our policy, you are well within the 90-day return window.
Oh, really? Ninety days? Wow, that's a huge relief. I was so worried I had missed it.
Not at all. Since you're within the timeframe, I can go ahead and process that return for a full refund for you right now. I'm sending a prepaid return label to the email address on your account.
Wow, thank you so much, Charlie! You've been a great help. That was so much easier than I thought it would be.
You're very welcome, Alex. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
My pleasure. Have a great day, and thank you for calling VeloFit.
